title: The ghost ship that drifted the Arctic for decades
hook: An abandoned cargo ship drifted around the Arctic for almost forty years.
summary: The cargo steamer Baychimo was abandoned in Alaskan ice in 1931, then kept being sighted drifting empty until 1969, and has never been found.
sources: Wikipedia: SS Baychimo - Hudson's Bay Company steamer trapped in ice off Alaska in October 1931, abandoned, sighted repeatedly for decades, last reported 1969
Hudson's Bay Company Archives / Canadian Encyclopedia entries on the Baychimo ghost ship

lines.text: An abandoned cargo ship drifted around the Arctic for almost forty years.
lines.caps: An *abandoned | ship drifted the *Arctic | for *forty years

lines.text: In nineteen thirty-one, the Baychimo got trapped in the ice off Alaska.
Its crew gave up and left it behind, full of furs.
Then a blizzard passed, and the ship was gone.
But it had not sunk. People kept seeing it, drifting miles away.
lines.caps: But it had *not sunk. | People kept *seeing it, | *drifting

lines.text: Some even climbed aboard, but no one ever managed to bring it home.
lines.caps: Some *climbed aboard, | but none could *bring it home

lines.text: The last report came in nineteen sixty-nine.
Did it sink? Is it still out there? Nobody knows. It has never been found.

post.caption:
A ship with no crew that wandered the Arctic for decades. Nobody knows where it ended up.
